name: Idaho
standard: ADA, Section 508 and 'most current enforceable' WCAG (ITS points to WCAG 2.1 AA)

laws.summary: Authority for the Idaho Technology Authority's web publishing policy.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: ITA Standard S5120 Web Publishing (not opened)

applies_to: Public-facing web pages under the idaho.gov domain; ITA policies apply to state agencies, including institutions of higher education.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Comply with ADA, Section 508 and current enforceable WCAG
Use the State Web Design Template and follow Standard S5120
Show multi-channel contact information on every page
mobile: not addressed — P5010 covers websites only.
enforcement: Exemptions go through ITA Policy P1010; no enforcement mechanism stated.
notes: No Idaho accessibility statute found. S5120 and G310 were not opened. The claim that ITA policies cover higher education comes from a search snippet. The ITS page cites the federal 2027/2028 dates. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
